name: agent-trust-layer
description: A trust, credential, and scoped-authority layer for AI agents: identity via did:key, claims via VC-JWT, verification, and a policy engine that gates task acceptance.

scripts.demo:all: npm run demo:happy && npm run demo:forged && npm run demo:revoked && npm run demo:no-creds && npm run demo:delegation && npm run demo:multi-hop && npm run demo:stolen && npm run demo:sybil
